note: Large Pine Ridge state park W of Crawford, around the historic fort. Two adjoining RV campgrounds SE of the fort buildings: Red Cloud (full hookups, 50 amp, herringbone pull-ins up to 70 ft) and Soldier Creek (sites 1-77; 50-amp Electric Plus plus basic, shaded). The separate Mare Barn campground NW of the fort serves horse campers. Modern restrooms, showers, dump/fill station. Reservable on ReserveAmerica up to 180 days ahead; open year round. State park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: The stored pin sits by the Mare Barn equestrian campground. The two RV campgrounds, Red Cloud and Soldier Creek, adjoin each other ~1.4 km SE (RA GIS + NAIP), so the pin should move. They are ~450 m apart on the same park road, which makes them one place and not a split. Mare Barn is a horse camp beside the 59-stall stables, out of scope. RA confirms 50 A full hookups at Red Cloud, Electric Plus at Soldier Creek, 70-ft maximum, open year round and 180-day booking. The stored RA link (parkId 230107) is broken; the park is parkId 230077. Phone (308) 665-2900 confirmed. Not waterfront.
